candidates.description: This vector represents mathematical symbols, relational operators, and logical equivalences used in equations and expressions.
Closing parentheses, curly brackets, and associated punctuation marks used in programming syntax.
This vector represents mathematical and LaTeX formatting symbols used for superscripts, subscripts, and equations.
